mapper.sql: id, message_id, media_asset_id, promoted_document_id, original_filename, content_type, byte_size, create_time
mapper.select: select from nad_message_attachment where message_id in #{i} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_message_attachment (message_id, media_asset_id, original_filename, content_type, byte_size, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{mediaAssetId}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_message_attachment set promoted_document_id = #{documentId} where id = #{id}
